standard: course-sentence-translation 技能 R1–R4；键取自对齐原串

entries.en: Professional athletes need their bodies to be in excellent condition.
entries.zh: 职业运动员需要让身体保持最佳状态。

entries.en: They train hours every day to achieve this.
entries.zh: 他们每天训练几个小时才能达到这个目标。

entries.en: Sometimes it only takes one small mistake to spoil all that hard work.
entries.zh: 有时候，一个小错误就会毁掉所有的努力。

entries.en: In 2011, for example, French golfer Thomas Levet won the French Open.
entries.zh: 例如，2011 年，法国高尔夫球手托马斯·勒韦赢得了法国公开赛。

entries.en: He was so happy that he jumped in a lake and broke his leg.
entries.zh: 他太高兴了，跳进湖里，结果摔断了腿。

entries.en: And American skier Lindsey Vonn cut her hand badly while she was opening a glass bottle to celebrate winning at the 2009 World Championships.
entries.zh: 美国滑雪运动员林赛·沃恩在庆祝赢得 2009 年世界锦标赛时，打开玻璃瓶严重割伤了手。

entries.en: We know you’re not professionals, but we want you to tell us all about your silliest sporting accidents.
entries.zh: 我们知道你们不是职业运动员，但我们想让你们讲讲自己最傻的运动事故。

entries.en: Last year, I was playing volleyball for my school team.
entries.zh: 去年，我在校队打排球。

entries.en: I jumped up high and hit the ball really hard.
entries.zh: 我高高跳起，用力击球。

entries.en: At first, I thought it was a really good shot, but I soon found out it wasn’t.
entries.zh: 起初我以为那球打得很漂亮，但很快就发现不是。

entries.en: The ball hit the post at the side of the net: then it hit me in the face and knocked me to the floor.
entries.zh: 球打在网边的柱子上：然后打在我脸上，把我击倒在地。

entries.en: I had a big purple bruise on my face and I couldn’t play the rest of the game.
entries.zh: 我脸上有一大块紫色淤青，剩下的比赛没法打了。

entries.en: When I was 13, I played for the school rugby team and we won the schools championship.
entries.zh: 我十三岁时在校橄榄球队打球，我们赢得了学校锦标赛。

entries.en: A few days later, there was a big celebration.
entries.zh: 几天后，有一个盛大的庆祝活动。

entries.en: All the students were there to watch as we walked on to the stage to get medals from the headmistress.
entries.zh: 所有学生都在那里看着我们走上舞台，从女校长手中接过奖牌。

entries.en: I got my medal, but when I was leaving the stage, I tripped and fell down the steps.
entries.zh: 我拿到了奖牌，但下台时绊了一下，从台阶上摔了下去。

entries.en: Luckily, I wasn’t hurt, but I was really, really embarrassed.
entries.zh: 幸运的是我没受伤，但我真的非常尴尬。

entries.en: A few days ago I was skateboarding down my road when I saw my best friend.
entries.zh: 几天前，我正在路上玩滑板，看到了我最好的朋友。

entries.en: I shouted to him and started waving.
entries.zh: 我朝他大喊，并开始挥手。

entries.en: While I was waving, I rode into a lamppost and fell off.
entries.zh: 挥手的时候，我撞上了路灯柱，摔了下来。

entries.en: My leg was hurting really badly and I couldn’t move.
entries.zh: 我的腿疼得厉害，动不了。

entries.en: After ten minutes, my friend called an ambulance.
entries.zh: 十分钟后，我的朋友叫了救护车。

entries.en: Finally, they took me to hospital.
entries.zh: 最后，他们把我送到了医院。

entries.en: The doctor there told me my leg was broken.
entries.zh: 那里的医生告诉我我的腿骨折了。

entries.en: Now I can’t skateboard for at least six months, and I have to miss the local championships.
entries.zh: 现在我至少六个月不能玩滑板，还得错过当地的锦标赛。
